comment: PromQL function definition for Kibana. See https://prometheus.io/docs/prometheus/latest/querying/functions/
name: limit_ratio
description: Returns a ratio `r` of the series from the input vector, keeping their full label set.

params.name: r
params.description: Ratio of series to keep (-1 ≤ r ≤ 1); the absolute value selects the share, a negative r inverts the selection.
